description: When Git provides only user.name, the identity step still says "Filled in from your Git configuration." while Email is empty.
expected: Copy reflects what Git actually supplied, e.g. "Name filled in from Git; enter the email people should see."
actual: Name prefilled, Email blank, helper text claims both came from Git.
suggested_fix: Choose the helper sentence from which fields Git returned (both, name only, email only, neither).

description: With no --harness flag (the plain `pardner open` path), the Welcome start form says "Setup agent (Codex) is registered as your agent" regardless of which agent actually opened Pardner.
expected: Either name the actual harness or use neutral wording when the harness is unknown.
actual: "Setup agent (Codex) is registered as your agent. It shows as offline until it connects…"
suggested_fix: Default the setup-agent label to "your setup agent" when no harness was given, or require the opener to pass its harness.
